content: अङ्गारकः, -कम् [अङ्गार खार्थे कन्] .²1 Charcoal. .²2 Mars; ˚विरुद्धस्य प्रक्षीणस्य बृहस्पतेः <ls>Mk. 9. 33</ls>; ˚चारः course of Mars. See chapter 6 of Bṛhat Saṃhitā. .²3 Tuesday (˚दिनम्, ˚वासरः). .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a prince of Sauvīra. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of two plants कुरण्टक and भृङ्गराज, Eclipta (or Verbesina) Prostrata (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>माका</ns>) and white or yellow Amaranth (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कोरांटी</ns>). .{@-कम्@} [अल्पार्थे कन्] .²1 A small spark. .²2 A medicated oil in which turmeric, Dūrvā, Mañjiṣṭhā and other substances have been boiled.
